name: Suitcase Carry
instructions: Stand tall with a heavy dumbbell in one hand at your side, as if carrying a suitcase.
Brace your core and resist leaning toward the weight, keeping your shoulders level and your ribs down.
Walk with short, steady steps for the set distance or time.
Switch hands and repeat on the other side.
image_prompt_scene: Standing tall holding one heavy dumbbell at the side.
